title: Layered Brand Story
desc: Overlapping 3D card layout organizing the brand story into Chapter 01 (Origin), Chapter 02 (Craft), and Chapter 03 (Future).
heading: The Three Chapters of Aurelia
subtitle: Explore the narrative layers of our maison.

chapters.title: The Florentine Origin
chapters.excerpt: It started in a small workshop overlooking the Arno River...
chapters.fullStory: Founded in Florence, our early days were defined by rigorous experimentation with natural vegetable dyes and traditional hand loom weaving.

chapters.title: The Master Craft
chapters.excerpt: Every garment passes through 48 pairs of skilled hands...
chapters.fullStory: We partner exclusively with family-owned ateliers where master tailors dedicate up to 14 hours of precision handwork to a single trench coat.

chapters.title: The Circular Horizon
chapters.excerpt: Designing for infinite life cycles and zero waste...
chapters.fullStory: Our future is focused on closed-loop recycling, natural regenerative agriculture, and building clothing that enriches the earth upon disposal.
